{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue_float == 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_no_internal = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & ~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_internal['revenue_float'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Print number of rows in the final population
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding internal test orders: {len(completed_no_internal)}")"}
